title: Richard Dedekind: Source-Checked Editions and English Translations
version: 2026-06-03 Dedekind GMW Volume I Item I through Article 8
description: Dedicated Richard Dedekind author record for source-checked editions and English translations. Current reader surface includes the collected Gesammelte mathematische Werke PDFs, the complete German/English edition of Was sind und was sollen die Zahlen?, the early Stetigkeit und irrationale Zahlen segment, Dedekind/Dirichlet paratext items LII-LIX, and a new source-checked German/English start of GMW Volume I, Item I, Über die Elemente der Theorie der Eulerschen Integrale, through Article 8.
notes: Current public surface adds GMW Volume I, Item I through Article 8. Article 9 begins at the printed page 18 boundary and is the next continuation point.
